title: Capturing the risk of persisting depressive symptoms: A dynamic network investigation of patients’ daily symptom experiences
limitations: - Limited number of assessments per participant; - Did not model random slopes due to overfitting; - Used median split for group assignment, which may not generalize to other populations.
notes: The study used a median split to assign participants to groups, which may not generalize to other populations. The authors did not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered, but the use of permutation testing suggests a methodological rigor.
